key_insight: Under a full row rank condition, a closed-form solution recasts tensor trace-ratio optimization as tensor least squares, enabling a randomized large-scale solver.
engineering_relevance: The approach targets computational and memory bottlenecks in high-dimensional tensor learning while supporting discriminative feature selection.
method: Replace generalized tensor eigenproblems with a tensor least-squares formulation.
Develop a randomized solver with theoretical error bounds.
Combine the closed-form result with tensor ℓ₂,₀ regularization for sparse multilinear discriminant analysis.
evidence_signal: Evaluations on multiple public real-world benchmarks report efficiency and scalability advantages, with competitive classification accuracy on some datasets.
watch_item: The closed-form result requires full row rank; applicability to rank-deficient data needs verification.
paper_title: Large-Scale Tensor Trace-Ratio Problem: Randomized Algorithm and Sparse Multilinear Discriminant Analysis via Closed-Form Solution
